name: soft-delete
title: Soft delete
description: Opt-in soft delete per resource: DELETE marks records deleted, queries hide them, admins can list and restore them.
docs:
Enable per resource: resource('post', { softDelete: true, fields: {...} })
DELETE /api/posts/:id now sets deletedAt. Admins: GET /api/posts/trash, POST /api/posts/:id/restore.
